The structure of Dy₃Fe₃ (DyFe) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing six atoms across two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Dy centers with 14 geometric neighbors (4 Dy and 10 Fe) and Fe centers with 10 neighbors (6 Dy and 4 Fe), with neighbor distances ranging from about 2.74 to 3.37 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing between Fe-centered 10-vertex polyhedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing between Dy- and Fe-centered polyhedra.
